<script>
(function(){
  var reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var g=function(t){var sd=t<58?18:26;return Math.exp(-Math.pow((t-58)/sd,2))};
  var X=function(t){return 10+t*2.8},Y=function(v){return 108-v*92},d='';
  for(var t=0;t<=100;t+=2){d+=(t?'L':'M')+X(t).toFixed(1)+' '+Y(g(t)).toFixed(1)}
  var line=document.getElementById('c-line'),area=document.getElementById('c-area');
  if(!line)return;
  line.setAttribute('d',d);area.setAttribute('d',d+'L'+X(100)+' 108L'+X(0)+' 108Z');
  var v=document.getElementById('c-v'),dot=document.getElementById('c-dot'),out=document.getElementById('c-out'),svg=line.ownerSVGElement;
  function at(t){t=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,t));var x=X(t),y=Y(g(t));
    v.setAttribute('x1',x);v.setAttribute('x2',x);dot.setAttribute('cx',x);dot.setAttribute('cy',y);
    out.textContent=Math.abs(t-58)<3?'Pic épidémique schématique.':'Incidence relative : '+Math.round(g(t)*100)+' %.'}
  var cur=58;at(cur);
  svg.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){var r=svg.getBoundingClientRect();cur=((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*300-10)/2.8;at(cur)});
  svg.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){cur+=3}else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){cur-=3}else return;e.preventDefault();cur=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,cur));at(cur)});
  var hero=document.querySelector('.hero');
  if(!reduce&&hero){var el=hero.querySelectorAll('.topo ellipse');
    hero.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){var r=hero.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5,y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;
      el.forEach(function(n,i){n.style.translate=(-x*(6+i*5))+'px '+(-y*(4+i*3))+'px'})})}
})();
</script>
